description: List detected competitor changes in a workspace, newest first, with summary, severity, why_it_matters, monitor_type, and review_status. meta.counts gives inbox totals; page with after set to next_cursor. For a summarized period, use get_digest; for evidence on one change, use get_change.

monitor_type.description: Kind of page: homepage, blog, docs, changelog, or pricing

review_status.description: unreviewed (in the inbox), acknowledged (seen and relevant), or dismissed (noise)

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, or a relative window: 1d, 7d, 30d

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from list_workspaces or create_workspace

name: list_changes
title: List changes
